select.if: select finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,null portFolioName,sum(marketValue) as marketValue, sum(dscCostAmt) as dscCostAmt,sum(shareAmt) as shareAmt, round(sum(nvl(assetHold.marketValue,0))/sum(assetHold.tdyAssetValue)*100,2) as marketValueRatio,null portfolioId,'02' as hasChildren ,'root' parentInfo,finprodMarketId childInfo,portfolioId1 from assetHold group by finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,portfolioId1

select null finprodMarketId,null finprodAbbr,portFolioName,marketValue,dscCostAmt,shareAmt, marketValueRatio,portfolioId,'01' as hasChildren ,finprodMarketId parentInfo,portFolioName childInfo,portfolioId1 from assetHold where finprodMarketId = #{parentId}

select finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,null portFolioName,sum(marketValue) as marketValue, sum(dscCostAmt) as dscCostAmt,sum(shareAmt) as shareAmt, sum(marketValueRatio) as marketValueRatio,null portfolioId,'02' as hasChildren ,'root' parentInfo,finprodMarketId childInfo,portfolioId1 from assetHold group by finprodMarketId,finprodAbbr,portfolioId1
